description: Image Description: The image depicts a collection of various items arranged on a flat surface. In the upper section, there is a coil of green paracord and a roll of duct tape, which has a gold piece of tape stuck to it. Below these, to the left, are a folding knife, a black lighter, a black permanent marker, and a manual toothbrush. Next to the toothbrush is a small screwdriver. A length of cord is laid out diagonally across the middle of the image.
